traits.description: The gorgon sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gorgon makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Smelting Charge (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The gorgon moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time the gorgon enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage, and the target is pulled into the gorgon's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14); if the gorgon already has a creature Grappled, the target has the Prone condition instead. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition. When the gorgon moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing no extra movement.

monsters.description: Followers of the exiled archdevil Moloch altered the process of creating gorgons to craft their own diabolical guardians called brazen gorgons. These gorgons are hollow, bull-like automatons whose metal bodies glow with intense heat. When they charge their foes, the ribs of their frames open like cages to ensnare enemies and roast them within. Brazen gorgons are often found in blasphemous sites dedicated to Moloch, other archdevils, or bloodthirsty gods.

monsters.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.

monsters.description: Where bronze dragons dwell, wonders flourish. Imaginative yet mindful, these metallic dragons work toward greatness and help others achieve all they can. They strive to preserve innovations, from the works of past civilizations to new discoveries, and they share such works widely. When dealing with shorter-lived beings, bronze dragons prefer to win them over through conversation and cultivation, but they don't shy from battle when villains keep others from achieving their potential. Bronze dragons enjoy the power and endless possibilities of the sea, and they often make their lairs in places of natural beauty or communities they wish to preserve. Within their dwellings, bronze dragons hoard things they believe will be useful one day. They salvage treasure lost to the sea, reclaiming wealth or sunken ships.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Bugbear Stalker

traits.name: Abduct
traits.description: The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bugbear makes two [[equipment:Javelin]] or [[equipment:Morningstar]] attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Quick Grapple
bonus_actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

monsters.description:
Bugbears embody fear of the wilds and the menace of natural places. They're notoriously stealthy, and foes that venture into their territories often vanish without a trace

Bugbear stalkers frequently take their victims hostage, relishing opportunities to imprison and terrorize other creatures.

monsters.name: Bugbear Warrior

traits.name: Abduct
traits.description: The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

actions.name: Grab
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Light Hammer
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (3d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.description:
Bugbears embody fear of the wilds and the menace of natural places. They're notoriously stealthy, and foes that venture into their territories often vanish without a trace

Bugbear warriors serve those who offer them treasure, food, or the chance to hunt challenging prey.

monsters.name: Bulette

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.description: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the bulette's destination space. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description: The bulette jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.description: Bulettes range under vast territories. They often threaten animal herds, and they can wipe out whole farming communities.

monsters.name: Bullywug Bog Sage

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The bullywug can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
traits.description: The bullywug can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bullywug makes two Bog Staff attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Ray of Sickness]].

actions.name: Bog Staff
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The bullywug casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks):
At Will: [[spell:Dancing Lights]], [[spell:Druidcraft]], [[spell:Ray of Sickness]]
1/Day Each: [[spell:Speak with Plants]], [[spell:Vitriolic Sphere]]

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description: The bullywug jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.description:
Fey embodiments of swamplands, bullywugs protect the murky wilds and consider themselves cosmically favored for that role. These human-size, toad- or frog-like creatures have close relationships with the creatures of the swamp.

Bullywug bog sages channel the magic of the swamp to sicken foes and speak with plants.

monsters.name: Bullywug Warrior

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The bullywug can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
traits.description: The bullywug can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

actions.name: Insectile Rapier
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description: The bullywug jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.description:
Fey embodiments of swamplands, bullywugs protect the murky wilds and consider themselves cosmically favored for that role. These human-size, toad- or frog-like creatures have close relationships with the creatures of the swamp.

Bullywug warriors are adept at moving through swamps and ambushing trespassers. They often work alongside packs of trained giant frogs

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cambion makes two attacks, using Claw or Fire Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cambion casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
2/day each: [[spell:Alter Self]], [[spell:Command]] (level 3 version), [[spell:Detect Magic]]
1/day each: [[spell:Dominate Person]] (level 8 version), [[spell:Plane Shift]] (self only)

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Carrion Crawler

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The carrion crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The carrion crawler uses Paralyzing Tentacles and makes one Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the carrion crawler can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

monsters.description: Ravenous corpse eaters, carrion crawlers gravitate toward places of slaughter and decay. In such charnel environs, they feast on the dead with no qualms about their meals' origins or freshness. Carrion crawlers have segmented bodies like gigantic cutworms. From beneath their multipart maws protrude eight thin, lashing tentacles. Creatures struck by these tentacles risk being paralyzed and consumed. Carrion crawlers scour sewers, battlefields, necropolises, and fetid wildernesses for corpses, clinging to ceilings to ambush smaller prey and to avoid competing hunters. They're drawn to light and the scent of blood, recognizing them as signs of food. These scavengers avoid ingesting inorganic material. Crypts with funeral armors sucked clean of their corpses and eerily pristine catacombs are signs of infestation by carrion crawlers.

traits.name: Jumper
traits.description: The cat's jump distance is determined using its Dexterity rather than its Strength.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Centaur Trooper

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur makes two attacks, using [[equipment:Pike]] or [[equipment:Longbow]] in any combination.

actions.name: Pike
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Trampling Charge (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.description: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

monsters.description: Centaur troopers are knight-like guardians. Many are suspicious of non-Fey creatures.

monsters.name: Centaur Warden

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur makes two attacks, using Forest Staff or Sun Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Forest Staff
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The centaur casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: [[spell:Druidcraft]], [[spell:Speak with Animals]]

actions.name: Sun Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 90 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the centaur's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Entangling Trail (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.description: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of the centaur as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.description: Centaur wardens often lead groups of centaur troopers and act as intermediaries between Fey creatures and trespassers into their territories.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

actions.name: Chain
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Conjure Infernal Chain
actions.description: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Success: The chain disappears.

reactions.name: Unnerving Gaze
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, the triggering creature. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. Success: The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If the chasme dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The chasme has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

bonus_actions.name: Drone
bonus_actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the chasme (demons automatically succeed on this save). Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 10 minutes or if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to empty a flask of [[equipment:Holy Water]] on it. Success: The target is immune to this chasme's Drone for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 31 (7d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Chuul
languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the [[spell:Detect Magic]] spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Acid damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

bonus_actions.name: Hasten (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.description: The golem takes the Dash and Disengage actions.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.description: While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.

actions.name: Attach
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Moan
bonus_actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the cloaker's next turn. Success: The target is immune to this cloaker's Moan for the next 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The cloaker casts the [[spell:Mirror Image]] spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Fog Cloud]].

actions.name: Thunderous Mace
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Thundercloud
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 240 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At Will: [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Fog Cloud]], Light
1/Day Each: [[spell:Control Weather]], [[spell:Gaseous Form]], [[spell:Telekinesis]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step
bonus_actions.description: The giant casts the [[spell:Misty Step]] spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Cockatrice

actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.

monsters.description: Cockatrices often try to claim eye-catching structures—such as ruins and secluded farms—as roosts.

monsters.name: Cockatrice Regent

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The cockatrice doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cockatrice makes one Petrifying Bite attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Magical Backlash
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature within 120 feet of the cockatrice deals damage to it. Response—Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, the triggering creature. Failure: 13 (3d6 + 3) Force damage.

monsters.description: Bolder than their smaller cousins, cockatrice regents brim with unstable magical energy they use to restrain distant foes.

monsters.name: Colossus
languages: Understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The colossus can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the colossus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The colossus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The colossus makes three attacks, using Slam or Radiant Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +18, reach 20 ft. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage, and the colossus pushes the target up to 20 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Radiant Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +18, range 300 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Radiant damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Divine Beam (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 26, each creature in a 300-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Failure: 65 (10d12) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this beam disintegrates into dust, leaving behind any magic items it was wearing or carrying.

legendary_actions.name: Smite
legendary_actions.description: The colossus makes one Radiant Ray attack.

legendary_actions.name: Stomp
legendary_actions.description: The colossus moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it can make one Slam attack at any point during that move.

monsters.legendary_actions_intro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the colossus can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The colossus regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

monsters.name: Commoner

traits.name: Training
traits.description: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.description: Commoners constitute the majority of people who don't pursue magical talents, extraordinary training, or a life of adventure. Some are generous, helpful sorts, while others are more cautious in sharing what they have.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature the snake can see within 5 feet. Failure: 7 (3d4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

monsters.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Slowing Breath
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.

monsters.description: Relentlessly friendly and curious, most copper dragons view the world as a place of endless wonder and possibility. These gregarious dragons are fonts of patience, hospitality, and humor, and they seek to improve the lives—or, at least, the mood—of those they interact with. If forced to fight to defend themselves or their friends, these dragons favor using their slowing breath and physical attacks to subdue antagonists. Only in cases of extreme peril or emotion do they use their deadly acid breath. Copper dragons typically live in caverns amid picturesque hills and rock formations—particularly those that are prominent landmarks. These dragons collect gifts, though they have little interest in treasure without meaning, no matter how valuable it is. To them, thoughtfully given presents and the feelings or memories they symbolize are more important than masterpieces or magical relics.

traits.name: Shielded Mind
traits.description: The couatl's thoughts can't be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the couatl's next turn.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature the couatl can see within 5 feet. Failure: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The couatl casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At Will: [[spell:Detect Evil and Good]], [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Detect Thoughts]], [[spell:Shapechange]] (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)
1/Day Each: [[spell:Create Food And Water|Create Food and Water]], [[spell:Dream]], [[spell:Greater Restoration]], [[spell:Scrying]], [[spell:Sleep]]

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The couatl casts [[spell:Bless]], [[spell:Lesser Restoration]], or [[spell:Sanctuary]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Crawling Claw

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 Necrotic damage.

monsters.description: Lone crawling claws can continue killing sprees they perpetrated in life. Some recklessly attack the living, while others pursue specific victims. In rare cases, a crawling claw wreaks mayhem while the rest of its body still lives, with the original creature potentially unaware of its severed hand's crimes.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

monsters.name: Cultist

actions.name: Ritual Sickle
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 1 Necrotic damage.

monsters.description: Cultists devote themselves to their faith's leaders and otherworldly masters. While this zeal grants cultists no magical powers, it gives them remarkable resolve in the face of threats. Cultists perform much of a cult's mundane work, which might include evangelism, criminal acts, or serving as sacrifices.

monsters.name: Cultist Fanatic

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):
At Will: [[spell:Light]], [[spell:Thaumaturgy]]
2/Day: [[spell:Command]]
1/Day: [[spell:Hold Person]]

bonus_actions.name: Spiritual Weapon (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The cultist casts the [[spell:Spiritual Weapon]] spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Cultist fanatics lead small cults or cells within larger cults. They're privy to more of a cult's mysteries than lower-ranking cultists are, granting them access to magical powers from their patrons.

monsters.name: Cultist Hierophant

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes three attacks, using Pact Blade or Radiant Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At will: [[spell:Thaumaturgy]]
1/day each: [[spell:Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance]] (level 7 version), [[spell:Mass Suggestion]]

monsters.description: Cultist hierophants are leaders who oversee the lives of their underlings, dictate the edicts of the cult, and interpret their patron's will. They possess supernatural powers gained from the cult's patron, supernatural sources, or the power of their own fanaticism. These leaders know their cult's deepest secrets and often control strange relics, mystical sites, and monstrous servants.

monsters.name: Cyclops Oracle

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes three attacks, using Radiant Strike or Flash of Light in any combination.

actions.name: Radiant Strike
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Flash of Light
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Radiant damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the cyclops's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cyclops casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
2/day each: [[spell:Arcane Eye]], [[spell:Detect Magic]],
1/day: [[spell:Legend Lore]]

reactions.name: Portent (Recharge 4–6)
reactions.description: Trigger: The cyclops or an ally it can see makes a D20 Test. Response: The cyclops rolls 1d20 and chooses whether to use that roll in place of the d20 rolled for the D20 Test.

monsters.description: Cyclops oracles gaze through history to learn hidden truths. Many share these secrets with those who aid them in correcting the mistakes of the past.

monsters.name: Cyclops Sentry

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cyclops makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Rock in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Limited Foresight (Recharge 6)
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the cyclops can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The cyclops imposes Disadvantage on the roll, and the cyclops gains Advantage on attack rolls against the target until the end of the cyclops's next turn.

monsters.description: Most cyclops sentries serve their divine progenitors and oppose those who would tamper with fate.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The dao can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dao doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.description: If the dao dies outside the Elemental Plane of Earth, its body dissolves into dirt, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Earth.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dao has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.description: The dao has a 30 percent chance of knowing the [[spell:Wish]] spell. If the dao knows it, the dao can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the dao can understand. If the dao casts the spell for the creature, the dao suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the dao has cast it three times, the dao can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dao makes three Earthen Maul attacks or two Earth Burst attacks.

actions.name: Earthen Maul
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Earth Burst
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Hit or Miss: Earth explodes from the target's space, creating the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from and including the target. Failure: 10 (3d6) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The dao casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: [[spell:Detect Evil and Good]], [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Stone Shape]]
1/day each: [[spell:Gaseous Form]], [[spell:Invisibility]], [[spell:Move Earth]], Passwall, [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:Tongues]], [[spell:Wall of Stone]]

monsters.name: Darkmantle

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its Speed becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
actions.description: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

monsters.description: Unnatural subterranean hunters, darkmantles veil themselves in magical shadows and use their bizarre anatomies to disguise themselves as stalactites. When prey passes below, lurking darkmantles drop and unfurl their webbed tentacles, attempting to blind, suffocate, or crush their victims. Darkmantles share similarities with piercers and ropers and often hunt near those monsters. Scholars have attempted to establish a shared origin or life cycle between those creatures, but their efforts are thwarted by those monsters' supernatural physiologies and deadly natures.

monsters.name: Death Cultist

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes three attacks, using Dread Scythe or Deathly Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Dread Scythe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Deathly Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At will: [[spell:Speak with Dead]], [[spell:Thaumaturgy]]

bonus_actions.name: Spirit Wail (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the cultist. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

monsters.description: Death cultists revel in nihilistic forces, embracing them as paths to undeath, multiversal purity, or entropic inevitability. These cultists serve powerful undead beings, apocalyptic prophecies, or immortals with power over death, such as Acererak, Kyuss, Orcus, Vecna, or Wee Jas.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target's Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).

monsters.name: Death Knight

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the death knight fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The death knight has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Marshal Undead
traits.description: Undead creatures of the death knight's choice (excluding itself) in a 60-foot Emanation originating from it have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.description: If the death knight is destroyed before it atones for its evil, it gains a new body in 1d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in a location significant to the death knight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The death knight makes three Dread Blade attacks.

actions.name: Dread Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Orb (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the death knight can see within 120 feet. Failure: 35 (10d6) Fire damage plus 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The death knight casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: [[spell:Command]], [[spell:Phantom Steed]]
2/day each: [[spell:Destructive Wave]] (Necrotic), [[spell:Dispel Magic]]

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The death knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The death knight adds 6 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

legendary_actions.name: Dread Authority
legendary_actions.description: The death knight uses Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Command]]. The death knight can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fell Word
legendary_actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature the death knight can see within 120 feet. Failure: 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. Failure or Success: The death knight can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Lunge
legendary_actions.description: The death knight moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Dread Blade attack.

monsters.legendary_actions_intro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the death knight can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The death knight regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
monsters.description: Death knights are deadly combatants and domineering commanders with grim histories. Some strive to end the curses that doom them to undeath, though their selfish souls eternally shackle them to their fates. Others, like the infamous death knight Lord Soth, brood in dismal ruins for centuries, rousing themselves to action only when something reignites their deathless evil.

monsters.name: Death Knight Aspirant

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The aspirant has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Marshal Undead
traits.description: Undead creatures of the aspirant's choice (excluding itself) in a 60-foot Emanation originating from it have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The aspirant makes three Dread Blade attacks.

actions.name: Dread Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Orb (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the aspirant can see within 120 feet of itself. Failure: 21 (6d6) Fire damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The aspirant casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: [[spell:Phantom Steed]]
1/day each: [[spell:Destructive Wave]] (Necrotic), [[spell:Dispel Magic]]

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The aspirant is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The aspirant adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monsters.description: When the leader of a villainous order rises as a death knight, their wicked devotees might join them in their cursed existence as death knight aspirants. These followers bear a measure of their leader's power and serve as they did in life, obediently following the death knight's decrees and heralding its terrible will.

monsters.name: Death Slaad

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The slaad regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes two Chaos Blade attacks.

actions.name: Chaos Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Until the start of the slaad's next turn, the target has a condition determined by rolling 1d4: on a **1**, Charmed; on a **2**, Frightened; on a **3**, Poisoned; or on a **4**, Incapacitated.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The slaad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Detect Thoughts]], [[spell:Invisibility]] (self only), [[spell:Mage Hand]], [[spell:Major Image]]
1/day each: [[spell:Blight]] (level 8 version), [[spell:Cloudkill]] (level 6 version), [[spell:Fly]], [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:Tongues]]

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.description: The slaad shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.description: Slaad lords create death slaadi by infusing gray slaadi with a portion of their chaotic energy. When groups of slaadi act deliberately, death slaadi are often behind their designs.

monsters.name: Death Tyrant

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the death tyrant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The death tyrant uses Eye Rays three times.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description: The death tyrant randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll 1d10; reroll if the death tyrant has already used that ray during this turn):

actions.name: 1: Charm Ray
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: 2: Paralyzing Ray
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: 3: Fear Ray
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: 4: Slowing Ray
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: 5: Enervation Ray
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 16 (3d10) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: 6: Telekinetic Ray
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (the target succeeds automatically if it is Gargantuan). Failure: The death tyrant moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The target has the Restrained condition until the start of the death tyrant's next turn or until the death tyrant has the Incapacitated condition. The death tyrant can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door or container.

actions.name: 7: Sleep Ray
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17 (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

actions.name: 8: Petrification Ray
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

actions.name: 9: Disintegration Ray
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot Cube of it disintegrates into dust. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

actions.name: 10: Death Ray
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 55 (10d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 Hit Points.

bonus_actions.name: Negative Energy Cone
bonus_actions.description: The death tyrant's central eye emits an imperceptible, magical wave of negative energy in a 150-foot Cone. Creatures in that area can't regain Hit Points until the start of the death tyrant's next turn. An intact Humanoid corpse there instantly rises as a Zombie under the death tyrant's control and takes its turn immediately after the death tyrant on the same initiative count.

legendary_actions.name: Chomp
legendary_actions.description: The death tyrant makes two Bite attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Glare
legendary_actions.description: The death tyrant uses Eye Rays.

monsters.legendary_actions_intro: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the death tyrant can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The death tyrant regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: The deer doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Demilich

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.description: If the demilich is destroyed, it reforms and regains all its Hit Points in 1d10 days unless a [[spell:Wish]] spell is cast on its remains.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The demilich makes three Necrotic Burst attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Howl (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the demilich. Failure: 70 (20d6) Psychic damage. Failure or Success: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the demilich's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Energy Drain
legendary_actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature the demilich can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 14 (4d6). Failure or Success: The demilich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Grave-Dust Flight
legendary_actions.description: The demilich flies up to its Fly Speed, shedding grave dust. Each creature within 5 feet of the demilich as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the demilich's next turn. Failure or Success: The demilich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Necrosis
legendary_actions.description: The demilich makes one Necrotic Burst attack.

monsters.legendary_actions_intro: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the demilich can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The demilich regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
monsters.description: A demilich is a skull harboring the remnants of a lich's wicked essence. If the burden of immortality overwhelms a lich, its consciousness turns inward as its body rots away. But if its remains are disturbed, a demilich rises. Demiliches usually appear as skulls adorned with gems or arcane sigils.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.description: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The deva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.

actions.name: Holy Mace
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At Will: [[spell:Detect Evil and Good]], [[spell:Shapechange]] (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)
1/Day Each: [[spell:Commune]], [[spell:Raise Dead]]

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The deva casts [[spell:Cure Wounds]], [[spell:Lesser Restoration]], or [[spell:Remove Curse]], using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The worg has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The worg makes three Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the worg's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.

actions.name: Dreadful Howl (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature within 30 feet that isn't a worg. Failure: 36 (8d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the worg's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Warp Step
bonus_actions.description: The worg teleports, along with a willing creature of its choice within 5 feet of it, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.description: If the displacer beast is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.description: Attack rolls against the displacer beast have Disadvantage, since it projects an illusion that makes it appear to be near its actual location. This trait is suppressed while the displacer beast has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The displacer beast makes one Rend attack and one Tentacle attack.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.description: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.description: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the [[spell:Wish]] spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Storm Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Storm Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.description: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At Will: [[spell:Detect Evil and Good]], [[spell:Detect Magic]]
2/Day Each: [[spell:Create Food And Water|Create Food and Water]] (can create wine instead of water), [[spell:Tongues]], [[spell:Wind Walk]]
1/Day Each: [[spell:Creation]], [[spell:Gaseous Form]], [[spell:Invisibility]], [[spell:Major Image]], [[spell:Plane Shift]]

monsters.name: Doppelganger

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.description: The doppelganger casts [[spell:Detect Thoughts]], requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

actions.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.description: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monsters.description: Doppelgangers are supernatural beings with the ability to shape-shift into any humanlike form. Their mind-reading abilities aid them in creating near-perfect disguises and plucking secrets from unguarded minds. Occasionally, doppelgangers use their shape-shifting ability in more overt ways, transforming into unsettling forms to frighten foes.

monsters.name: Dracolich

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Life Suppression
traits.description: Creatures within 60 feet of the dracolich can't regain Hit Points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dracolich has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Gem
traits.description: The dracolich has a magical gem. If the dracolich is destroyed while the gem is on the same plane of existence as it, the dracolich gains a new body in 1d20 days, regaining all its Hit Points and appearing within 5 feet of the gem. The gem is a Tiny object that has AC 20; HP 50; and Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The gem regains all its Hit Points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the gem is destroyed, the dracolich can create a new one by completing an 8-hour ritual using a gem worth 1,000+ GP and by expending 5,000 GP, which the ritual consumes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dracolich makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Ray of Sickness]] (level 2 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The dracolich casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Ray of Sickness]] (level 2 version)
1/day each: [[spell:Create Undead]] (level 8 version), [[spell:Finger of Death]]

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description: The dracolich moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary_actions.name: Sickening Ray
legendary_actions.description: The dracolich uses Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Ray of Sickness]] (level 2 version). The dracolich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Terrifying Presence
legendary_actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the dracolich. Failure: 11 (2d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dracolich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monsters.legendary_actions_intro: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the dracolich can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dracolich regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

monsters.name: Dretch
languages: Abyssal; telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fetid Cloud (1/Day)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the dretch. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the creature can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

monsters.description: Lone dretches serve other demons or evil magic-users. They are erratic, filthy, and violent, and they demonstrate little sense of self-preservation.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Poison Burst
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.description: The drider casts [[spell:Darkness]], [[spell:Faerie Fire]], or [[spell:Web]], requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

monsters.name: Druid

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Vine Staff
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Verdant Wisp
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: [[spell:Druidcraft]], [[spell:Speak with Animals]]
2/day each: [[spell:Entangle]], [[spell:Thunderwave]]
1/day each: [[spell:Animal Messenger]], [[spell:Longstrider]], [[spell:Moonbeam]]

monsters.description: Druids use primal magic, traditional teachings, and bonds with animals and eldritch beings to guard the natural world and heal its ills. These magic-users might be recluses devoted to a particular land, or they might be part of a mystic organization.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dryad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.description: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Charm Monster]].

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Thorn Burst
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At Will: [[spell:Animal Friendship]], [[spell:Charm Monster]] (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again), [[spell:Druidcraft]]
1/Day Each: [[spell:Entangle]], [[spell:Pass without Trace]]

bonus_actions.name: Tree Stride
bonus_actions.description: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

monsters.name: Dust Mephit

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

actions.name: Sleep (1/Day)
actions.description: The mephit casts the [[spell:Sleep]] spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

monsters.description: Dust mephits are composed of air and fine earth. They are drawn to forsaken places, and they think everything associated with death is hilarious.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 feet. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock Launch
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.description: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The efreeti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.description: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the [[spell:Wish]] spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Heated Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 120 ft. Hit: 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At Will: [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Elementalism]]
1/Day Each: [[spell:Gaseous Form]], [[spell:Invisibility]], [[spell:Major Image]], [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:Tongues]], [[spell:Wall of Fire]] (level 7 version)

monsters.name: Elemental Cultist

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes three attacks, using Elemental Flail or Elemental Claw in any combination.

actions.name: Elemental Flail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) damage of a type chosen by the cultist: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

actions.name: Elemental Claw
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) damage of a type chosen by the cultist: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the cultist moves the target up to 10 feet straight toward or away from itself.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: [[spell:Elementalism]], [[spell:Mage Hand]]

reactions.name: Elemental Absorption (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The cultist takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. Response: The cultist gives itself Resistance to that instance of damage and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

monsters.description: Elemental cultists harness destructive natural forces to cleanse the world of civilization or prove the dominance of one element over all others. Such cultists are aligned with Elemental monsters or wicked immortals such as the Princes of Elemental Evil or the Elder Elemental Eye.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elephant makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Trample
bonus_actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the elk moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Empyrean

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The empyrean makes two attacks, using Sacred Weapon or Divine Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Sacred Weapon
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) Force damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the empyrean's next turn. The target can choose not to be Stunned, in which case it takes an extra 21 Force damage that bypasses Resistance or Immunity.

actions.name: Divine Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +15, range 600 ft. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The empyrean casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23):
At Will: [[spell:Calm Emotions]], [[spell:Greater Restoration]], [[spell:Pass without Trace]], [[spell:Water Breathing]]
1/Day Each: [[spell:Commune]], [[spell:Dispel Evil and Good]], [[spell:Plane Shift]]

legendary_actions.name: Bolster
legendary_actions.description: The empyrean gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, and the empyrean and each ally within 30 feet of it gain Advantage on D20 Tests until the end of the empyrean's next turn. The empyrean can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Shockwave of Glory
legendary_actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the empyrean. Failure: 27 (6d8) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The empyrean can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Smite
legendary_actions.description: The empyrean makes one Divine Ray attack.
