monsters.legendary_actions_intro: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the empyrean can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The empyrean regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
monsters.description: Inheritors of divine might, empyreans are idealized, human-shaped beings of godly power. These beings might have relationships with their creators akin to those of parents and their children, royalty and their servants, inventors and their creations, or other bonds. Empyreans' existences are fundamentally influenced by their patrons and their connection to the heavenly deities of the Upper Planes or the fiendish deities of the Lower Planes. Nevertheless, empyreans have free will. Celestial empyreans are typically noble beings who quest to prove themselves worthy of their divine pedigree. Many work in the service of their parents or support those gods' causes and champions. Fiendish empyreans are usually dreadful, self-serving villains who seek to claim their parents' power. Some forge unholy armies or rule over hidden realms in mockery of true gods, while others might seek to escape their accursed families.

monsters.name: Empyrean Iota

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The empyrean can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Otherworldly Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5. reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The empyrean casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
1/Day Each: [[spell:Bless]], [[spell:Lesser Restoration]] (as an action)

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The empyrean casts [[spell:Healing Word]], using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Empyrean iotas are the thoughts, memories, or indirect attentions of deities personified and given a measure of autonomy. Resembling floating glyphs, motes of color, icons of divinity, or stranger shapes, these beings are messengers of the gods and aides to those gods' servants. Iotas have their own knowledge and personalities, though they might know little more than the realms and wishes of their creators.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The erinyes has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Rope
traits.description: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

actions.name: Withering Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a Bonus Action to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to m

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Web Strand (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

bonus_actions.name: Reel
bonus_actions.description: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Faerie Dragon Adult

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Incapacitated, the target uses all its movement on each of its turns to move in a random direction.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: [[spell:Dancing Lights]], [[spell:Mage Hand]], [[spell:Minor Illusion]]
1/day each: [[spell:Hallucinatory Terrain]], [[spell:Polymorph]]

bonus_actions.name: Superior Invisibility
bonus_actions.description: The dragon casts [[spell:Greater Invisibility]] on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: The pranks of faerie dragon adults tend to lead others to people in need or wrongs to be righted.

monsters.name: Faerie Dragon Youth

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn and uses all its movement on its turn to move in a random direction.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
At will: [[spell:Dancing Lights]], [[spell:Mage Hand]], [[spell:Minor Illusion]]

bonus_actions.name: Superior Invisibility
bonus_actions.description: The dragon casts [[spell:Greater Invisibility]] on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Faerie dragon youths are quick to use their euphoria-inducing breath on rude or uptight folk.

monsters.name: Fiend Cultist

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cultist makes three Pact Axe attacks.

actions.name: Pact Axe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: [[spell:Scorching Ray]] (level 5 version), [[spell:Thaumaturgy]]
2/day: [[spell:Fireball]] (level 6 version)

reactions.name: Hellish Rebuke
reactions.description: The cultist casts [[spell:Hellish Rebuke]] in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Fiend cultists worship fiends or evil deities. They often work to bring ruin to innocents or to summon their sinister patron into the world. Fiend cultists might serve infamous powers such as archdevils and demon lords, or foul immortals—beings such as Demogorgon, Pazuzu, Iuz, Zariel, or Zuggtmoy.

monsters.name: Fire Elemental

traits.name: Fiery Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

actions.name: Burn
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

monsters.description: Fire elementals arise when spirits of the Elemental Plane of Fire inhabit flames, burning cinders, and heated smoke. These beings are tangible despite largely being made of flames and particles, and they can uses their vague limbs to ignite foes and flammable materials. Fire elementals typically burn in shades of orange and red, but other colors are possible. Most on the Material Plane are summoned by magical means, or they might appear near rifts amid desert depths, volcanoes, wildfires, or magma flows that connect to their home plane.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

actions.name: Flame Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hammer Throw
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The flameskull sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The flameskull has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.description: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its Hit Points in 1 hour unless [[equipment:Holy Water]] is sprinkled on its remains or the [[spell:Dispel Evil and Good]] spell is cast on them.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The flameskull makes two Fire Ray attacks.

actions.name: Fire Ray
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The flameskull casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]]
2/day: [[spell:Magic Missile]] (level 2 version)
1/day: [[spell:Fireball]]

monsters.name: Flaming Skeleton
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: The skeleton explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the skeleton. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The skeleton sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The skeleton makes two attacks, using Flame Scepter or Hurl Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Flame Scepter
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Fire damage.

monsters.description: Flaming skeletons burn with unbridled necromantic energy. This magic grants them blazing attacks and greater awareness, which they use to command lesser Undead.

monsters.name: Flesh Golem
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.description: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.description: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

monsters.name: Flumph
languages: Understands Undercommon but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Advanced Telepathy
traits.description: The flumph perceives the content of any telepathic communication within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Prone Deficiency
traits.description: If the flumph receives the Prone condition, roll a die. On an odd number, it has the Incapacitated condition. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, ending the Incapacitated condition on a success.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.description: The flumph's thoughts can't be read by any means, and magic can't detect its location or observe it remotely.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Acid damage.

actions.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature the flumph can see within 15 feet. Failure: The target is coated in a foul-smelling liquid, exudes a stench for 1d4 hours, and has the Poisoned condition while the stench lasts. Other creatures have the Poisoned condition while in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the coated target. The target can remove the stench on itself if it bathes during a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The snake doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Warping Hex (Recharge 4–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the fomorian can see within 120 feet. Failure: 21 (6d6) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The frog can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The frog's Long Jump is up to 10 feet and its High Jump is up to 5 feet with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.

actions.name: Frost Axe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: War Cry (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.description: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

monsters.name: Galeb Duhr
monsters.speed_text: 15 ft. (30 ft. when rolling, 60 ft. rolling downhill)

actions.name: Avalanche Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the galeb duhr moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Animate Boulders (1/Day)
actions.description: The galeb duhr magically animates one or two boulders it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each boulder uses the Galeb Duhr stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1 and lacks this action. The boulder takes its turn immediately after the galeb duhr on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the galeb duhr. A boulder remains animate for 1 minute or until it or the galeb duhr dies.

monsters.name: Gargoyle

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

monsters.description: Gargoyles are sculptures inhabited by elemental spirits. Wings and magic allow their heavy stone bodies to fly, and they often perch where they can blend in amid ornate architecture, rock formations, or mundane statues. Gargoyles usually serve the magic-users who conjured them into their bodies, but if left to their own devices, they might play cruel pranks and steal treasures to hoard in lofty lairs.

monsters.name: Gas Spore Fungus

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: The gas spore bursts when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the gas spore. Failure: The target takes 10 (3d6) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for 1d12 hours. Unless the Poisoned condition is removed, the target dies at the end of that time and sprouts 2d4 Tiny **Gas Spore Fungi** (each with 1 Hit Point). After 2d6 days, they become Large and have 13 Hit Points.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +0, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.description: Gas spores are floating, orbicular fungi with rhizome growths and protuberances that resemble the stalks and eyes of beholders. If destroyed, a gas spore explodes in a poisonous burst that can infect creatures and slay them in hours. Infected corpses spawn more gas spores that grow to full size in a matter of days.

monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube

traits.name: Ooze Cube
traits.description: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube have Total Cover, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.description: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn't witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The cube moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze Cube trait). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. Failure: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the Restrained condition, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. Success: Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.

monsters.description: Quivering masses of acidic goo, gelatinous cubes wobble through narrow caverns and dungeons, engulfing anything in their paths. These Oozes are naturally transparent, making them difficult to see while they're stationary. Creatures and objects that become stuck within these slimes are gradually dissolved. Undigested detritus sometimes floats within a gelatinous cube, hinting at its past meals.

monsters.name: Ghast

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the ghast. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a non-Undead creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.description: Ghasts frequently organize ghouls into packs to despoil crypts and steal the wealth within.

monsters.name: Ghast Gravecaller

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the ghast. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghast makes two Horrific Necrosis attacks. It can replace one attack with a Claw attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target isn't an Undead, it has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Horrific Necrosis
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The ghast casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:
At will: [[spell:Speak with Dead]], [[spell:Thaumaturgy]]

monsters.description: Ghast gravecallers wield fell magic and converse with corpses. They might pose as liches or vampires.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.description: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghost makes two Withering Touch attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.description: The ghost casts the [[spell:Etherealness]] spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The ghost is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrific Visage
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Cone that can see the ghost and isn't an Undead. Failure: 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the ghost's next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours.

monsters.name: Ghoul

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ghoul makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't an Undead or elf, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.description: Ghouls rise from the bodies of cannibals and villains with depraved hungers. They form packs out of shared voracity.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.description: The ape hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description: The ape jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.name: Giant Axe Beak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The axe beak makes one Sharpened Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Sharpened Beak
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage, and a creature within 5 feet of the target (axe beak's choice) takes 6 (1d12) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

monsters.description: Giant axe beaks typically dwell in secluded, primeval realms, such as isolated islands or underground wildernesses. They often compete with dinosaurs and other giant beasts for territory.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.description: The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the centipede's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The snake makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature the snake can see within 10 feet. Failure: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11) from one of two claws.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The crocodile makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the crocodile's Tail.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

languages: Celestial; understands Common and Primordial (Auran) but can't speak them

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.

If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The beetle sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +1, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Fire damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The frog's Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The frog swallows a Small or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog. While swallowing the target, the frog can't use Bite, and if the frog dies, the swallowed target is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition. At the end of the frog's next turn, the swallowed target takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage. If that damage doesn't kill it, the frog disgorges it, causing it to exit Prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the goat moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Rampage (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that was already Bloodied, the hyena can move up to half its Speed, and it makes one Bite attack.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from all eight tentacles. While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

reactions.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The octopus takes damage while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 10-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

languages: and Sylvan but can't speak them

The owl casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
At will: [[spell:Detect Evil and Good]], [[spell:Detect Magic]]
1/day: [[spell:Clairvoyance]]

actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 feet. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.

actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Poison damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The vulture has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Gouge
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The wasp doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.description: The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.

traits.name: Gibbering
traits.description: The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:
The target does nothing.
The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the mouther, leaving only equipment behind.

actions.name: Blinding Spittle (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 30 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mouther's next turn.

monsters.name: Githyanki Dracomancer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githyanki makes three Draconic Strike attacks.

actions.name: Draconic Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the githyanki's next turn.

actions.name: Conjured Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (6d8) Fire damage plus 27 (6d8) Force damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The githyanki casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible)
2/day each: [[spell:Nondetection]] (self only), [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:Tongues]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The githyanki casts [[spell:Misty Step]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: One of Gith's last deeds was to forge an alliance between the githyanki and the dragon god Tiamat. Ever since, the Dragon Queen's red dragon consort, Ephelomon, and his kind have been allies of the githyanki. Githyanki dracomancers uphold this pact and cultivate magic talents that complement the might of red dragons.

monsters.name: Githyanki Knight

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githyanki makes three Silver Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[spell:Telekinesis]] if available.

actions.name: Silver Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. Critical Hit: If the target is in an astral body (as with the [[spell:Astral Projection]] spell), the githyanki can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body instead of dealing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The githyanki casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible)
2/day each: [[spell:Nondetection]] (self only), [[spell:Tongues]]
1/day each: [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:Telekinesis]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The githyanki casts [[spell:Misty Step]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Githyanki knights wield silver blades to slay magic-users who use the [[spell:Astral Projection]] spell to intrude on githyanki territories on the Astral Plane. These silver blades are sacred to the githyanki. Non-githyanki who claim these weapons often find themselves hunted by wrathful githyanki knights.

monsters.name: Githyanki Warrior

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githyanki makes two Psi Blade attacks.

actions.name: Psi Blade
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The githyanki casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible)
2/day: [[spell:Nondetection]] (self only)

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The githyanki casts [[spell:Misty Step]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Githyanki warriors use psionic abilities to augment their battle prowess.

monsters.name: Githzerai Monk

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githzerai makes two Psi Strike attacks.

actions.name: Psi Strike
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The githzerai casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible)
1/day: [[spell:See Invisibility]]

bonus_actions.name: Psi-Powered Leap (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The githzerai casts [[spell:Jump]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Psionic Defense (2/Day)
reactions.description: The githzerai casts [[spell:Feather Fall]] or [[spell:Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Githzerai monks pursue control of their minds by honing their physical and psionic talents. They might be found beyond githzerai sanctuaries, testing themselves amid the dangerous extremes of the multiverse.

monsters.name: Githzerai Psion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githzerai makes three Psychic Warp attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Warp
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 26 (4d10 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the githzerai's choice of (A) the Charmed condition until the start of the githzerai's next turn or (B) the Prone condition, provided the target is a Large or smaller creature.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The githzerai casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible)
1/day each: [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:See Invisibility]]

reactions.name: Psionic Defense
reactions.description: The githzerai casts [[spell:Feather Fall]] or [[spell:Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: These powerful psions oversee githzerai sanctuaries, study enigmatic planar events, and lead rrakkma—hostile forays into mind flayer colonies to slay illithids and uncover secrets of how the ancient gith were transformed.

monsters.name: Githzerai Zerth

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The githzerai makes two Psi Strike attacks.

actions.name: Psi Strike
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The githzerai casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At will: [[spell:Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible)
1/day each: [[spell:Phantasmal Killer]] (level 6 version), [[spell:Plane Shift]], [[spell:See Invisibility]]

bonus_actions.name: Psi-Powered Leap (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The githzerai casts [[spell:Jump]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Psionic Defense (2/Day)
reactions.description: The githzerai casts [[spell:Feather Fall]] or [[spell:Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.description: Githzerai zerths embody the discipline espoused by their first leader, Zerthimon. Their psionic control aids them in protecting their people and traveling the planes of existence without fear of being followed by githyanki or mind flayer foes.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature Grappled by the glabrezu. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At Will: [[spell:Darkness]], [[spell:Detect Magic]], [[spell:Dispel Magic]]
1/Day Each: [[spell:Confusion]], [[spell:Fly]], [[spell:Power Word Stun]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gladiator makes three Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that the gladiator can see. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The gladiator is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monsters.name: Gnoll Demoniac

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gnoll makes two Abyssal Strike attacks.

actions.name: Abyssal Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hunger of Yeenoghu (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The gnoll conjures a 30-foot Cube of magical Darkness originating from a point it can see within 60 feet, which lasts for 1 minute or until the gnoll's Concentration ends on it. This area is Difficult Terrain. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, any creature that starts its turn in this area or enters it for the first time on a turn. Failure: 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage, and the gnoll or a creature of its choice it can see gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Rampage (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Abyssal Strike attack.

monsters.description:
The first gnolls arose from hyenas that fed on flesh tainted by the Abyss. Their corruption and violence delighted the demon lord Yeenoghu, who encouraged their numbers and spread them across the multiverse. Ever since, gnolls have been the cackling servants of Yeenoghu, existing to cause ruin and to feast on what remains.

Gnoll demoniacs are berserkers that arise from gnolls who've ritualistically fed on flesh corrupted by the Abyss. Now embodying the ruinous hunger of Yeenoghu, these gnolls throw themselves into battle, heedless of odds or their own survival. Rampaging demoniacs even devour other gnolls in their wild frenzies.

monsters.name: Gnoll Fang of Yeenoghu

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gnoll makes one Bite attack and two Bone Flail attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the gnoll's next turn.

actions.name: Bone Flail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Rampage (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Bite attack.

monsters.description:
The first gnolls arose from hyenas that fed on flesh tainted by the Abyss. Their corruption and violence delighted the demon lord Yeenoghu, who encouraged their numbers and spread them across the multiverse. Ever since, gnolls have been the cackling servants of Yeenoghu, existing to cause ruin and to feast on what remains.

Gnolls possessed by demonic vestiges of the demon lord Yeenoghu, fangs of Yeenoghu direct the chaos of gnoll packs. Along the way, these fanatics seek grisly omens from Yeenoghu and strive to interpret the demon lord's vicious goals.

monsters.name: Gnoll Pack Lord

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gnoll makes two attacks, using Bone Whip or Bone Javelin in any combination, and it uses Incite Rampage if available.

actions.name: Bone Whip
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bone Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Incite Rampage (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The gnoll targets another creature it can see within 60 feet of itself that has the Rampage Bonus Action. The target can take a Reaction to make one melee attack.

bonus_actions.name: Rampage (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Bone Whip attack.

Ever since, gnolls have been the cackling servants of Yeenoghu, existing to cause ruin and to feast on what remains.

Rising above other gnolls with their viciousness and physical prowess, gnoll pack lords terrorize weaker gnolls into their service. These brutes drive other gnolls to acts of great violence, then claim the best of their servants' spoils.

monsters.name: Gnoll Warrior

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Bone Bow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Rampage (1/Day)
bonus_actions.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

monsters.description:
The first gnolls arose from hyenas that fed on flesh tainted by the Abyss. Their corruption and violence delighted the demon lord Yeenoghu, who encouraged their numbers and spread them across the multiverse. Ever since, gnolls have been the cackling servants of Yeenoghu, existing to cause ruin and to feast on what remains.

Gnoll warriors crave endless slaughter but quickly grow bored with the prey they kill and the treasures they plunder. Nevertheless, they're enraged by the thought of anyone else having what's theirs, compelling them to despoil what they can't take with them.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage, or the goat deals 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage if it moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit.

monsters.name: Goblin Boss

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goblin makes two attacks, using [[equipment:Scimitar]] or [[equipment:Shortbow]] in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Medium or Small ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

monsters.description:
Goblins are Feywild embodiments of recklessness and ruin. They delight in wreckage—the louder, the more energetic, and the more convoluted, the better. Goblin raids are often as much opportunities to enjoy setting fires and tormenting livestock as they are parts of more disruptive plots. Goblins obey those who accomplish the wildest plans. Such leaders might be goblin raid masterminds, bombastic magic-users, or those capable of making the loudest noises. Hobgoblins and forceful humanoids might also command ornery groups of goblins, directing their destructiveness toward banditry, sabotage, or war.

Goblin bosses are often the most imaginative, disruptive, or forceful goblins. Through a combination of luck, cowardice, and callousness, these leaders avoid harm at the expense of their followers.

monsters.name: Goblin Hexer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The goblin makes two Hex Stick attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Hex Stick
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The goblin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: [[spell:Minor Illusion]]
1/day each: [[spell:Blindness/Deafness]], [[spell:Faerie Fire]], [[spell:Grease]]

reactions.name: Jinx
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack misses instead.

Goblins are Feywild embodiments of recklessness and ruin. They delight in wreckage—the louder, the more energetic, and the more convoluted, the better. Goblin raids are often as much opportunities to enjoy setting fires and tormenting livestock as they are parts of more disruptive plots. Goblins obey those who accomplish the wildest plans. Such leaders might be goblin raid masterminds, bombastic magic-users, or those capable of making the loudest noises. Hobgoblins and forceful humanoids might also command ornery groups of goblins, directing their destructiveness toward banditry, sabotage, or war.

Goblin hexers use flashy and disruptive magic. Many goblin hexers are theatrical, dressing and behaving in exaggerated mimicry of archmages.

monsters.name: Goblin Minion

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

Goblin minions enjoy participating in the disruptive schemes of clever leaders but are quick to flee when confronted by their comeuppance.

monsters.name: Goblin Warrior

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

bonus_actions.description: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
